title: Relative finite-stage factorization of compact coherent cocones
statement:
Use the universes, $\kappa$-smallness, $\kappa$-filteredness and $\kappa$-compactness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], the coherent diagrams and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the join $\star$ and right cone $K^{\triangleright}=K\star\Delta^0$ of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $\kappa$ be an infinite regular cardinal in the smaller universe and let $\mathcal E$ be a locally small quasicategory admitting all small $\kappa$-filtered colimits. Let $K'\subseteq K$ be a simplicial subset of a $\kappa$-small simplicial set and $q:K\to\mathcal E$ a diagram with $\kappa$-compact values at all vertices. Let $I$ be a small nonempty partially ordered set in which every subset of cardinality less than $\kappa$ has an upper bound, and let $\bar p:N(I)^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal E$ be a colimiting cocone with apex $c$ at its final vertex $\infty$. Here a cocone $\bar p:N(I)^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal E$ is colimiting when its induced coherent cocone, obtained by precomposition with the map $N(I)\times\Delta^1\to N(I)^{\triangleright}$ that keeps the initial $N(I)$-vertices of each interval simplex and sends its final vertices to the cone vertex, is a colimiting cocone of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Suppose that
$$r:K'\star N(I)^{\triangleright}\longrightarrow\mathcal E$$
restricts to $q|_{K'}$ on $K'$ and to $\bar p$ on $N(I)^{\triangleright}$. Suppose also that $u:K\star\{\infty\}\to\mathcal E$ restricts to $q$ on $K$, has apex $c$, and agrees with $r$ on $K'\star\{\infty\}$. Then there exist $i\in I$ and a simplicial map
$$v:K\star\Delta^1\longrightarrow\mathcal E$$
with the following exact restrictions. On $K$ it is $q$; on $K\star\{1\}$ it is $u$, identifying $1$ with $\infty$; on $\Delta^1$ it is the edge $\bar p(i\to\infty)$; and on $K'\star\Delta^1$ it is $r\circ(\mathrm{id}_{K'}\star\iota_i)$, where $\iota_i:\Delta^1\to N(I)^{\triangleright}$ is the edge $i\to\infty$. No colimit of $q$ or $q|_{K'}$ is assumed to exist.
